column1: # Curated regions that are re-assembled locally before variant calling.
# Coordinates are 1-based inclusive and refer to the extended per-gene
# reference (HLA_<gene>), i.e. they already include the 5' flank from
# extend.fa. They are therefore only valid for the representative alleles
# listed in genes.tsv; if a representative allele is changed these regions
#   gene   Gene symbol, must appear in genes.tsv.
#   mode   whole = full-length typing only, exon = exon typing only,
# The build writes the matching subsets to select.region.txt (whole + both)
# and select.region.exon.txt (exon + both), restricted to the genes present
